requisitionList.Title: Lead Coating Technician
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
Shift: One week of 7am -3pm: Mon -Fri, then a week of 3pm – 11pm: Mon - Fri, and rotate that schedule every other week.

Leads shift activities in the operation of automated and manual thin film coating chambers. Programs design sequencing for evaporation requirements. Monitors the evaporation process for precise end points of multiple thin film coating layers. Oversees the operation of all TFP volume standard and nonstandard coating chambers through for proper setup, tear downs, operational modes and miscellaneous setup maintenance. Documents in detail all evaporation data, relaying abnormalities to shift lead and/or supervisor. Works as a team player supporting all shift work activities. Trains new employees and audits the procedures of other technicians on the shift. Coordinates production schedules to assure operation efficiencies are met. With supervisor, conducts employee appraisals for assigned shift technicians.

requisitionList.Title: Manager, University Relations & Global Mobility
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
Job Summary: The Manager of University Relations and Global Mobility will develop and deliver programs that strengthen Coherent’s future talent pipeline and support the movement of talent across our global organization.

With a primary focus on the United States, this role will build strategic relationships with universities, technical colleges, research institutions, and professional organizations to attract high-potential students and graduates. The Manager will oversee internship, graduate, and other early-career programs, creating a consistent and engaging experience from attraction and selection through development and conversion.

The role will also manage global mobility and employment-based immigration activities involving the United States.

requisitionList.Title: General Manager Integrated Circuits Business Unit
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: Job SuCoherent Corp. (NYSE: COHR) is a $6B+ global leader in materials, networking, and lasers for the industrial, communications, electronics, and instrumentation markets. It was founded in 1971 to manufacture high-quality materials and optics for industrial lasers. Today, the company operates in over 20 countries worldwide, is headquartered in Saxonburg, PA (near Pittsburgh), and has a significant presence in the Bay Area (Santa Clara), CA, Europe and Asia. Coherent is focused on delivering innovations that fuel market megatrends while pursuing our mission of making the world safer, healthier, closer, and more efficient. Coherent empowers market innovators to define the future through breakthrough technologies, from materials to systems. The company enjoys a strong patent position, and its vertical integration is a significant asset in controlling supply, manufacturing, and technology innovation.

requisitionList.Title: Sr. Manufacturing Engineer
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
The Senior Manufacturing Engineer — Advanced Thermal Management will support the transition of Coherent’s advanced thermal management products from development into repeatable, customer-ready manufacturing.

This role will support semiconductor packaging hardware, liquid cold plates, thermal spreaders, advanced ceramic/diamond materials, embedded cooling structures, and related thermal assemblies. The position will work across engineering, manufacturing, quality, operations, supply chain, product management, and customer-facing teams to define manufacturing processes, improve manufacturability, support pilot builds, and prepare products for scale-up.

requisitionList.Title: Senior/Lead Engineer
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
The AI/ML & Automation Development Engineer joining our Automation Engineering team will support the Sherman Wafer Fabrication facility. In this role, he or she will develop and deploy Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and advanced data analytics solutions to improve manufacturing performance while designing, implementing, and supporting Factory Automation, Advanced Process Control (APC), and Fault Detection & Classification (FDC) solutions across the fab.
The Automation Engineer will work on projects that address customer requirements and solve complex manufacturing challenges related to yield improvement, process stability, equipment performance, throughput, and cycle time. Leveraging manufacturing data from process and metrology systems, equipment sensors, and factory automation platforms, this engineer will develop intelligent, data-driven solutions while supporting and enhancing APC/FDC and SECS/GEM for ne incoming tools fab-wide.

requisitionList.Title: University Relations & Talent Acquisition Specialist
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
Job Summary: Reporting to the Manager of University Relations and Global Mobility, the University Relations & Talent Acquisition Specialist will support Coherent’s university relations, early-career recruiting, and Talent Acquisition programs. This role will help build relationships with universities, technical colleges, student organizations, and professional associations to attract interns, co-op students, apprentices, new graduates, and other early-career talent.

The Specialist will coordinate recruiting activities from sourcing and candidate engagement through interviewing, offer administration, onboarding, and program support. The role will also assist with university events, employer branding, recruiting communications, reporting, and process improvement.
The successful candidate will be organized, service-oriented, proactive, and comfortable working with students, candidates, hiring managers, recruiters, HR business partners, university representatives, and external partners.
